name: BREAD
full_name: Broadband Reflector Experiment for Axion Detection
summary: BREAD combines a cylindrical conversion surface and coaxial reflector for broadband dark-matter searches; GigaBREAD is its microwave prototype.
detection_principle: A geometric reflector concentrates dark-matter-conversion photons emitted from a conducting surface onto a sensor; adding a magnetic field enables axion sensitivity.

sites.name: Argonne National Laboratory; early prototype at the University of Chicago
sites.location: Argonne National Laboratory; early prototype at the University of Chicago

results.summary: No axion signal; coupling limits were obtained in this band, while the higher-frequency final design remains a subsequent development.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
